ValidationRule.description: Enforces required fields on Personal Clients without making them required on Corporate Accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Private_Client", OR( ISBLANK(Name), ISBLANK(Primary_Email__c), ISPICKVAL(Relationship_Context__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Preferred_Contact_Method__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Data_Sensitivity_Flag__c, "") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Private Client requires: Primary Client Full Name, Primary Email, Relationship Context, Preferred Contact Method, and Data Sensitivity Flag. Please complete all required fields before saving.
